breadcrumb: Std 9 Social Science (English) — History Unit 10: Industrial Revolution — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: Reasons for the Industrial Revolution beginning in England: abundant resources and colonies, access to coal, iron and raw cotton, infrastructure for textiles developed by immigrant artisans from the Netherlands, developed banking, Royal Society encouragement, political stability.

en.q: Which of the following was NOT a reason for the Industrial Revolution beginning in England?
options: Access to coal, iron and raw cotton from the colonies
Political instability caused by civil wars

ta.q: இங்கிலாந்தில் தொழிற்புரட்சி முதலில் தோன்றியதற்குக் காரணம் அல்லாதது எது?
options: உள்நாட்டுப் போர்களால் ஏற்பட்ட அரசியல் நிலையற்ற தன்மை

questions.quote: Thomas Newcomen invented a contrivance to pump water out of mines but it consumed too much fuel. James Watt, a Scottish engineer, converted a stationary steam engine to a rotary engine which consumed less fuel.

en.q: James Watt improved the Newcomen engine mainly by:
options: adding a safety lamp for the miners
making a rotary engine that used less fuel
using water power in place of steam
making it portable on iron rails
en.explanation: Newcomen's pump consumed too much fuel.

ta.q: நியூகோமன் இயந்திரத்தை ஜேம்ஸ் வாட் முக்கியமாக எவ்வாறு மேம்படுத்தினார்?
options: குறைந்த எரிபொருள் எடுக்கும் சுழல் இயந்திரமாக மாற்றினார்

questions.quote: The rolling mill proved to be fifteen times faster than hammering wrought iron. Hot blast greatly increased fuel efficiency. In 1856, Henry Bessemer discovered a faster and cheaper method of producing steel.

en.q: The rolling mill proved to be how many times faster than hammering wrought iron?
en.explanation: Hot blast greatly increased fuel efficiency in iron production.

ta.q: உருளை ஆலை சம்மட்டியால் அடித்து இரும்பை உருவாக்குவதை விட எத்தனை மடங்கு வேகமாக இருந்தது?
ta.explanation: சூடான காற்றூதல் இரும்பு உற்பத்தியில் எரிபொருள் திறனை மிகுதியாக்கியது.

questions.quote: In 1842, the British Parliament published a report about the state of coal mining – the Mines Report. Children were employed in textile mills because they worked for lower wages. Typhoid, cholera and smallpox broke out in labourers' housing.

en.q: Why were children employed in textile mills in the Industrial Revolution?
en.explanation: The 1842 Mines Report exposed conditions in coal mining.

ta.q: தொழிற்புரட்சிக் காலத்தில் ஜவுளி ஆலைகளில் குழந்தைகள் ஏன் பணியமர்த்தப்பட்டனர்?

questions.quote: In 1771, Manchester was a sleepy town of 22,000 people. Over the next fifty years its population exploded and reached up to 180,000. The city of London grew from a population of two million in 1840 to five million in forty years.

en.q: Manchester, a sleepy town of 22,000 people in 1771, grew within fifty years to a population of about:
en.explanation: London grew from two million in 1840 to five million in forty years.

ta.q: 1771-இல் 22,000 மக்கள் வாழ்ந்த மான்செஸ்டர் ஐம்பதாண்டுகளில் ஏறத்தாழ எவ்வளவு மக்கள்தொகையை அடைந்தது?

questions.quote: The Reform Bill of 1832 granted voting rights only to the propertied middle class. Chartism was active between 1836 and 1848. The Chartists called for voting rights to every man over twenty-one, secret ballot, abolition of property qualification for MPs, annual parliamentary elections and equal representation.

en.q: Industrial Revolution: Which of the following was NOT a demand of the Chartists?
options: Abolition of property qualification for MPs
Voting rights for women over eighteen
en.explanation: The Chartists demanded votes for every man over twenty-one.

ta.explanation: இருபத்தொரு வயதுக்கு மேற்பட்ட ஆடவர் அனைவருக்கும் வாக்குரிமையே கோரப்பட்டது.

questions.quote: In 1891 Armand Peugeot produced his first batch of automobiles. In 1898 Louis Renault built the quadricycle; Societe Renault Freres. In 1806 agriculture employed about 65.1% in France, decreasing to 42.5% by 1896.

en.q: According to the textbook, Armand Peugeot produced his first batch of automobiles in:
en.explanation: Peugeot began in 1891; Renault produced the quadricycle in 1898.

ta.q: பாடநூலின்படி ஆர்மன் பியூஜோ தம் முதல் தொகுதி வாகனங்களை உருவாக்கிய ஆண்டு:

questions.quote: The Prussian government created the Railway Fund in 1842. The number of factories in Prussia grew from 419 in 1837 to 1,444 in 1849. Iron production rose from 46,000 tons in 1810 to 529,000 tons by 1850. Prussia united Germany in 1871.

en.q: In 1842, the Prussian government created the Railway Fund in order to:
en.explanation: Berlin became a centre of the railroad network.

ta.q: 1842-இல் பிரஷ்ய அரசு இருப்புப்பாதை நிதியத்தை எதற்காக உருவாக்கியது?

questions.quote: In the first quarter of the eighteenth century, a law was enacted prohibiting the use of Indian calicoes and silks in England. Weavers of Bengal suffered. By the first quarter of the nineteenth century the export of Dacca muslin to England stopped. The Collector of Madurai reported that families of about 5000 weavers did not have the means to take more than one meal of rice a day.

en.q: Because of the Industrial Revolution, India lost her old industrial position and became an exporter of:
en.explanation: Loss of the market for hand-woven cotton goods ruined Indian weavers; the export of Dacca muslin to England stopped.

ta.q: தொழிற்புரட்சியின் விளைவாக இந்தியா தன் பழைய தொழில் நிலையை இழந்து எதன் ஏற்றுமதியாளராக மாறியது?
ta.explanation: கைத்தறித் துணிகளுக்கான சந்தை இழப்பால் நெசவாளர் பாதிக்கப்பட்டனர்; டாக்கா மஸ்லின் ஏற்றுமதி நின்றது.
